tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search restaurants, cafés and bars recommended by food creators on saved.rsvp. Give words (an area, a dish, a cuisine or kind of place, e.g. "greasy spoon shoreditch", "pie and mash", "dim sum") and/or coordinates to search nearby. Each result says who recommends it, their rank and guide, a quote in

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: One creator’s full review of a place, with address, what to order, their rank and guide, and which other creators recommend it too.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: A whole guide (e.g. "London Greasy Spoon Guide"), in the creator’s order with their ranks and quotes.

tools.name: who_recommends
tools.description: Check a specific restaurant: which creators on saved.rsvp recommend it, and what they say.

tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: The food creators on saved.rsvp, what they cover, and their guides.
